changes: ImGui helper - added a drawInt analogous to drawFloat - This mimics the element for floats - including double click to change values (as opposed to existing draw slider for ints which hard locks to limits AFAIK).
Kawase Debug Updates
ability to change number of passes (requires frame rebuild - push the button)
ability to change the height limiter (also causes rebuild - push the button)
Added Transfer Planner and Flight Planner to the "View" Menu, from their orphaned window.
Refactored PlaySound functions to take in positionEgo.
Added some fake shading and light transparency to the gizmos to give a bit of depth and make it easier to maintain visual understanding of the world without fighting for camera angles.

Write code for adding ambient planet reflections to vessels Code was written for adding ambient planet reflections to vessels, but is currently commented out as it is finnicky to adjust and doesn't add much to the look. Fixing the PBR system is higher priority, and I will come back and finish this code once that is done.
Added an EgoToView function to Camera and transform from EGO->VIEW before playing camera-relative audio.
Updated Fmod Brutal Version to 0.0.2
Changed Audio roll off factor from 1 to 0.1. This reduces how quickly 3d sounds fade out as the camera moves away.
Readded the maneuver gizmo deadzone in a more sophisticated way so it doesn't ever overlap with just clicking on the gizmo at odd angles.
Removed old maneuver node identifier.
Added some more visual feedback when interacting with the maneuver gizmo.
Removed the Vehicle backreference from Maneuver.
Replaced EccentricAnomaly and CelestialPosition on Maneuver with Patch and OrbitPointCce.
Added Warp To button back to the temp maneuver UI.
Fixed the draw orbit points/degree markers and made them available as well as their checkbox in debug builds.
Added MathEx.ToOrbitAngle which will wrap radians to between -Pi and Pi radians.

Changed all orbital calculations and transfer orbit calculations to use -Pi to Pi radians instead of 0 to 2*Pi radians. This also fixes invalid line drawing when vehicle wraps around Pi to -Pi in their orbit.
Changed Orbit owner info in the UI to now ONLY display if you are hovering over an orbit line with Shift key held down. Reduces clutter and some overlapping in the UI.
Added first pass of ground track window. Also includes development of a base class to help standardize vehicle windows.

Add vulkan debug labels on debug builds, makes it easier to see at a glance an easy breakdown of frame rendering costs and a labeled timeline of events in external profiling tools like nsight and renderdoc. Added a detailed breakdown for atmosphere, clouds and exhausts.
Added solar terminator and shading projection to the ground tracking. Need stefan to check I am correctly using the projections from the different frames.
Added mouse hover information on ground tracking to show the lat/lon/alt for the current mouse location
Added different map types (currently none, terrain, height), with support for more later (biomes etc).
Added toggle option for subsolar point in Ground Tracking window.
buf fix: added new memory barrier to kawase final upscale to fix the "screen of darkness where only the sun can live bug" when resizing or using unhappy resolutions

bug fix (part 2) in kawase - using actual height pushed down to the compute shader for the upsample comparisons rather than the extents; the "screen of darkness where only the sun can live bug" should be slain...again
added debug checkbox to toggle between using height limit and scalefactor for kawase height limits. Height limit now defaults to 1/16.
removed debug option to modify blurmixlerp for now - uncomment to use this debug option
Fixed ground track subsolar point position for objects which do not orbit the sun.
Increased the polys for the cone.
Tweaked the size of a non-selected maneuver node.
Fixed duplicate vehicles in the CelestialSystem objects lists.

Moved Transfer Planner out of Vehicle class/instance. Is now static. Will be converted to a Modal Window. Now allows transfer planning for any vehicle independent of what the camera is currently following.
Fixed doubling of paused notifications when pausing.
Fixed Auto warp continuing when maneuver was deleted.
Fixed auto warp not updating when maneuver was changed.
Fixed pause notification not being cleared when auto warping from pause.
Added ability to stop auto warp by changing sim speed.
Tweaked the map mode to stick to the following object and zoom out rather than move to the parent's view.

Moved Transfer Planner out of Vehicle class/instance. Is now static. Will be converted to a Modal Window. Now allows transfer planning for any vehicle independent of what the camera is currently following.
Changed the ground track view to display 3 orbits of true ground track instead of the instantaneous track.
Renamed OrbitPointCce.DeltaTime to TimeSincePe for clarity.
Merged ToOrbitAngle() and ToDeviationAngle(), since they do the same thing.
Added support for streaming larger audio files. StreamFromDisk Flag should only be used for music and ambience files.
Added debug audio window.
Fixed dropdown combos not remaining open on Transfer Planner UI.
Modified map view to default to parent frame of reference and increased the size a bit.

Refactored coloring for patches and orbit lines. Now the current orbit track is Green, the next patch (from an encounter) is a lighter blue. Future patches are reduced in both brightness and saturation, to help visualize later patched conics. Will be added as setting next.

Refactored Maneuver coloring. Now it is a burned yellow, to differentiate it from the current orbit and patches. This will also reduce brightness and saturation for each subsequent one. Will be added as setting next.
Fixed potential index out of range exception during ground track index search.

Write code to transition to new PBR system (still commented out) Code was written to slowly switch to the new PBR system, but is still commented out as it's not ready yet. I'm committing this to reduce possible merge conflicts as I implement reflections now.
Added detecting if your mouse is nearby the maneuver node and if not then we can hide the rate of change cones.
Made it so left clicking anything but maneuver nodes unfocuses the maneuver node.
Changed the 'add maneuver' button to left click from shift right click.
Fixed color darken could make a color completely black. Now clamping.
Optimized the ground tracking window to use stack allocation.
Added alpha fading for orbit lines on ground tracking.
Minor missing commit from ground tracking.
Tweaked the 'map view' to use the stars reference and a bit more default distance from the orbit object.
Fixed the maneuver menu not showing up properly for maneuvers that aren't last in the the maneuver list.
Added some handling so you don't accidentally drag a maneuver node when trying to select it.
Removed the IPatchedConics backreference from ManeuverPlan.
Removed the Vehicle backreference from FlightComputer.
Fixed Alert text was not being drawn in foreground so would be hidden by other ImGui widgets.
Added color settings to game settings for Orbit Line, Patch Line, and Maneuver Lines. Currently changes are not applied to existing objects, only new or upon restart.
Added 3I/ATLAS the newly discovered extrasolar object. Used current epoch.
Fixed hyperbolic orbits line rendering was heavily concentrated close to the sun and not using all the available orbit points.
Moved per-vehicle-reconfiguration info stored on FlightComputer into a class so we don't copy it around on every frame.
Fixed Orbit line points handling to correctly handle -PI to PI and to spread the points out correctly around the orbit using True Anomaly instead of Eccentric Anomaly.
